scope: One independent static source-bound screen of the five mandatory filled/capped process vias against every source component PTH/NPTH pad and, separately, the 13 other retained vias. No native KiCad operation, board generation, routing, cloud operation, quote, order, or source-board change.

comparison_policy.source_statement: The bound POFV article says more than 0.45 mm from regular PTH/NPTH; its diagram labels clearance >=0.45 mm.
comparison_policy.screen_rule: Conservatively require each computed whole-boundary lower bound to be >0.45 mm. No center-to-center interpretation is made.
comparison_policy.interpretation_limit: The supplier source does not completely specify its measurement boundary. Treating the 13 other retained vias as potentially non-filled for this conservative spacing branch is only a screening assumption. Their actual fill, off-pad and process disposition is separate and unresolved, and the results are not declared supplier violations or process qualification.
comparison_policy.fabrication_tolerance: Not modeled or qualified. Numerical tolerance is only for calculation/comparison and is not a fabrication allowance.
comparison_policy.inconclusive_rule: A conservative lower bound <=0.45 mm would be INCONCLUSIVE rather than proof of an actual geometric conflict; exact geometry and supplier interpretation would then be required.

prior_report_revision.disposition: Root-read provisional geometric-reasoning revision preserved by hash; this revision adds provenance clarification only.

execution_evidence_ledger.evidence_source: Agent tool-runtime completion record returned in-session; not an independently saved supervisor receipt.
execution_evidence_ledger.pid_status: Not returned by the recorded synchronous tool completion.
execution_evidence_ledger.hard_timeout_status: No independently saved hard-timeout or supervisor receipt exists. The recorded 90 seconds was the synchronous tool initial-wait setting and must not be represented as a proved process hard timeout.
execution_evidence_ledger.stdout_artifact_status: Completion output was returned in-session but was not independently saved as an artifact.

population_and_identity.inventory_basis: All source component pads, including unfitted and copper-only references; no fitted-BOM filter.

algorithm.coordinates: Saved native GLOBAL pad positions and orientations keyed by pad UUID/reference are used directly; footprint-local coordinates are not transformed to reconstruct pad positions.
algorithm.literal_geometry: Pad type, shape, size, drill shape/dimensions, and drill offset presence come from the source S-expression.
algorithm.hole_envelope: A circular drill uses radius diameter/2. An oval drill uses a rotation-independent enclosing circle centered on the globally rotated drill-offset center with radius max(drill dimensions)/2.
algorithm.pad_envelope: Circle and oval copper use enclosing radius max(size)/2. Rectangular/roundrect copper would use the corner radius hypot(size_x/2,size_y/2). Unsupported/custom geometry fails closed.
algorithm.gap: Euclidean center distance minus both enclosing radii. For pads this is a conservative lower bound on actual whole-shape separation; retained vias are circular and their edge gaps are exact for nominal source geometry.
algorithm.offset_handling: All eight drilled pads have no literal drill-offset field. This absence is recorded explicitly; effective [0,0] follows the KiCad format default and was not silently substituted. A present offset is rotated by saved native global pad orientation.
algorithm.limits: Circumscribed circles may understate true clearance, never overstate it for the supported shapes. Nominal source geometry is screened; manufacturing variation, plating, cap geometry and supplier measurement convention are outside this calculation.

other_retained_via_screen.screening_assumption: For this conservative branch only, the 13 vias are treated as potentially non-filled features that might fall under the supplier spacing statement. This does not establish that any is ordinary, off-pad, non-filled or process-qualified.
other_retained_via_screen.process_disposition_limit: Actual fill, off-pad and process dispositions remain separate. In particular, the four retained PROT_FET_RETURN vias 1cb9cba6-90b8-5033-9ae1-e912259b9b0a, 358bf155-f890-5806-b895-ec3c485c3ac2, 800d4ec3-d77e-5045-aaea-e1b064b8e71f and f0eb8165-a384-559b-a075-caa04a27f771 are not automatically qualified ordinary vias.

mandatory_seed_mutual_spacing.note: The other four mandatory filled/capped seeds were excluded from each other-retained-via set. Mutual seed geometry is not treated as a regular-PTH supplier-rule failure.

edge_cuts_coverage.disposition: The complete board-level Edge.Cuts inventory is one closed connected component. No separate non-pad Edge.Cuts component representing an internal hole was found.
edge_cuts_coverage.coverage_limit: This static topology disposition does not classify non-Edge.Cuts fabrication drawings, mechanical models, or supplier-added features.

applicability_and_nonqualification.applies_to: Only the exact current coordinates and exact retained177 membership bound above.
applicability_and_nonqualification.does_not_generalize_to: Future movable-part coordinates, added/replaced vias, generated full input, returned routing, or another source hash.
applicability_and_nonqualification.qualification_limit: Published hole/ring capability plus this static spacing screen does not qualify cap planarity, resin/copper-cap process, stencil/assembly, supplier capability for this design, native-guard behavior, actual selected stackup/full input, cloud behavior, fabrication, manufacturing, powered function, safety, or child use.
